environment.description: Django application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB target group has a custom attribute `slow_start.duration_seconds=30`. An AWS Global Accelerator endpoint routes traffic through edge locations. Rate limiting is enforced via an Envoy sidecar proxy in the ECS task definition with a local ratelimit filter configured at 2 requests per 10-second window per source IP per path prefix `/api/v1/users/search`, using a token bucket descriptor with `fill_interval: 10s, max_tokens: 2, tokens_per_fill: 2`. The Envoy filter returns HTTP 429 before the request reaches the Django WSGI process. The ratelimit descriptor key is derived from `x-forwarded-for` header (guaranteed accurate since Envoy is a sidecar within the same task, not a separate hop). Additionally, the ECS task has a read-only root filesystem and the container runs as non-root UID 1000.
